learning.title: How It Works
learning.body:
Each ORG has members. Each member is projected as a USER repo inside that ORG: `github.com/{org}/{user}`. As work happens, that repo accumulates governed evidence.

```
github.com/{org}/{user}
VITAE.md → identity declaration
MAGIC validates → compliance score
```

The federation learns which ORGs + USER projections govern well. COIN flows to WORK. VITAE proves the WORK happened.
